hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — Ace, Queen, Ace. You bet. Your opponent raised you back.

wrongReasons: A 7 plays similarly, but the correct hand pairs a specific board card that A 7 doesn't. Look at which hole card ranks actually appear on the board.
With only one pair, 8 5 wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
With only two pair, 10 10 wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 4 A

Your opponent flopped three of a kind and raised the flop immediately to build the pot. Sets are too strong to slow-play — they pushed their advantage on every street.
